name: unique_typeclass
expr: [uc, ia, ic] = unique('cbabc'); us = unique('cbabc','stable'); ul = unique(L); uj = unique(J); uk = unique(K);
comment: unique on char/logical/integer input. MATLAB PRESERVES the input class on the unique VALUES while ia/ic stay double. Fingerprints read values via double(...). Covers char ('cbabc'->'abc', ia=[3 2 1] first-occurrence, ic=[3 2 1 2 3]), 'stable' (->'cba'), logical ([0 1]), int8 ([1 2 3]), uint16 column vector (3x1 orientation preserved). The ; inside uint16([30;10;30;20]) is a matrix-row separator, not inside a quoted string. bugs/builtin/unique-typeclass.md.
